people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: The priest answered David, and said, “I have no common bread, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.”
translations.bsb: “There is no common bread on hand,” the priest replied, “but there is some consecrated bread—provided that the young men have kept themselves from women.”
translations.kjv: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.
translations.asv: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under my hand, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.
